query: SELECT r.name, r."isSystem", COUNT(DISTINCT rp."permissionId") AS direct_grants, COUNT(DISTINCT ur."userId") AS assigned_users FROM "Role" r LEFT JOIN "RolePermission" rp ON rp."roleId" = r.id LEFT JOIN "UserRole" ur ON ur."roleId" = r.id WHERE r.name IN ('admissions_officer','cashier','finance_approver','payroll_preparer','payroll_reviewer','payroll_approver') GROUP BY r.name,r."isSystem" ORDER BY r.name
